analyst_view.overall: Hajduk Split (13th, 6 pts) host Sint-Truiden (10th, 7 pts) with both still in range of the knockout places, so neither side has a reason to hold back. Poljud is closed to regular fans after UEFA punished the flares and fan misconduct at the Ajax game; Hajduk will fill it with about 8,000 invited children, and Sint-Truiden's own supporters will not travel at all. Hajduk come in on a run of three straight league wins (2-1 at Lokomotiva on Saturday, top of the HNL), still without centre-back Dennis Hadzikadunic (calf, which the numbers now count), Pajaziti, Ivusic and Brajkovic, while young winger Marin Soticek sat out the weekend as a precaution. Sint-Truiden are unbeaten in two under new coach Jonas De Roeck (4-1 v Zulte Waregem, 2-2 at Charleroi on Saturday) and report no new injuries; the numbers' momentum already counts both sides' recent scoring. No referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Hajduk's missing centre-back Hadzikadunic is now on the numbers' list (about +6% to Sint-Truiden's goals), so my earlier small lean for him is dropped to avoid counting it twice. Both sides' recent scoring, Hajduk's three straight league wins and Sint-Truiden's lively start under De Roeck, is already in the momentum adjustment, so I stay at 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.4 corners, with Hajduk's recent corner count nudged up and Sint-Truiden's down by momentum. The near-empty stadium and the new Sint-Truiden coach don't point clearly to more or fewer corners, so I stay at 8.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. I lean a little lower, to about 3.6: with Poljud closed to the regular fans, only invited children in the stands and no away supporters, there is far less crowd pressure on players and referee, which the numbers can't see. No referee is named yet; both sides' recent card counts are already counted (about -4% and -3%).

shots.text: The numbers say 25.9 shots. Sint-Truiden's busy attacking and Hajduk's tight recent defending are both in the momentum adjustment (Sint-Truiden -6% given who they face), and the team news has no new absence that changes shot volume, so I stay at 25.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target, already trimmed for Hajduk conceding few on target lately (Sint-Truiden -7%). Hadzikadunic's absence is already counted on the goals side and nothing else in the news changes how often either side tests the goalkeeper, so I stay at 9.0.
